On the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], a '''Hutt spectator''' watched a fight organized by the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Durrsk]]. However, when Durrsk was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by his own fighter, [[Tyrnia Masak]], as revenge, the Hutt was also killed. Its family placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Masak.
